en: The Dyads on Taints and Association with Taints, and the Dyads on Roots.

Dependent on a state that is both an *āsava* and associated with an *āsava*, and which is a root, there arises a state that is neither an *āsava* nor dissociated from an *āsava*, and which is not a root, by way of root-condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is associated with an *āsava* but is not itself an *āsava*, and which is a root, there arises a state that is neither an *āsava* nor dissociated from an *āsava*, and which is not a root, by way of root-condition … one.
(Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are four … pe … under non-disappearance [condition] there are four.

Dependent on a state that is both an *āsava* and associated with an *āsava*, but is not a root (*na-hetu*), there arises a state that is dissociated from an *āsava*, is neither an *āsava* nor a root, by way of the root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*) … one.

Dependent on a state that is associated with an *āsava* but is not an *āsava* and is not a root, there arises a state that is dissociated from an *āsava*, is neither an *āsava* nor a root, by way of the root-condition … three. (Abbreviated. Under the root-condition.
